thread:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Hosted-infer us-west-2 p99 latency > 5s and 5xx fraction spike (SLO burn). dashboard: https://app.redwood/dash/inf-gw/usw2
alyssa_sre: ack, I'm on it. seeing customer SLO alerts too. any correlating deploys?
khalid_eng: not aware of infra deploys in last 2h. there was a model rollout earlier (quant-variant v2) around 1741236000 - but that was traffic-scoped to canary.
maya_support: multiple customers opened tickets: req-9f4b2c, req-c3a1e4. both show 502/504. customers report timeouts from our API.
ryan_obs: pulling traces now. quick check: sampling for gateway traces dropped to 2% at 1741239000 -> trace coverage gap. likely why we don't see full path.
alyssa_sre: query pls — need logs + error-rate by backend. also check proxy conn errors.
ryan_obs: logs hint: upstream connection resets + backend TLS handshake timeouts. running a logsql: `service=ingress-gateway | http.status in [502,504] | count() by upstream_host, error_message`
ryan_obs: sample results: host=hosted-infer-batcher-3, error= "connection reset by peer"  (spike ~17:36-17:42 UTC)
khalid_eng: batcher-3 shows higher CPU and kernel drops on host metrics. can someone check pod restarts/oom?
alyssa_sre: nodes in AWS ASG show increased socket backlog. `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAIT and some SYN_RECV. suspect file-descriptor exhaustion on proxy side.
maya_support: affected customers are mostly on dedicated bursts but hitting hosted path via fallback. priority: escalate to support-eng for customer comms.
ryan_obs: creating a temporary dashboard snapshot: https://app.redwood/dash/snap/abc123 - added logs, metrics, traces (low-sample warning).
alyssa_sre: mitigation proposal: 1) enable route fallback to model-variant-lite for hosted-infer (reduce backend pressure), 2) increase gateway fd limit and connection pool, 3) roll back canary if correlated.
khalid_eng: I can bump gateway listen backlog + fd on the proxy group; will deploy config change via deploy-bot. any objections?
deploy-bot: Started rollout: gateway/fd-tweak -> canary -> 3 pods. (deploy id d-7721)
alyssa_sre: while that rolls, let's run these repro steps to validate: curl test with 100 concurrent short requests to /v1/generate (model=redwood-large) with header `X-Request-ID: repro-502-1` and capture tcpdump on proxy.
khalid_eng: running repro now from us-west instance. first run: 12% 502 with upstream reset within 30s. tcpdump shows server FIN after 4-5s, backend side TLS renegotiate.
ryan_obs: traced one failing request: gateway->batcher3 (no span for batcher internals due to sampling). we need to bump trace sampling for the next 20m to capture full waterfall. `obsctl sample set gateway 50%`
alyssa_sre: done. sampling bumped. please keep the repro running.
maya_support: notified affected customers that we're investigating and enabling fallbacks; asked for any request ids. they gave two more: req-77b2d, req-aa11ff.
khalid_eng: gateway fd patch canary shows improved connection queue and fewer resets on canary pods. rolling to 50% now.
alyssa_sre: good. follow-ups: 1) open an incident ticket and link these req ids, 2) run kprobe to capture TLS handshake failures on batcher nodes, 3) postmortem to include why trace sampling dropped and why canary wasn't isolated.
ryan_obs: incident opened: INC-2024-953. added dashboard + logs links. temporarily increased prefetch timeout on batcher to reduce upstream aborts.
deploy-bot: Rollout d-7721 successful -> gateway fd changes at 50% then 100% completed.
alyssa_sre: alert rate down to baseline after config changes and fallback. p99 latency back under 1.2s. closing SLO burn alert.
maya_support: will follow up with customers and update tickets. thanks team. :thumbsup:
alyssa_sre: will run a short post-incident test and schedule a follow-up meeting at 2024-08-21T18:00Z to review telemetry gaps and add a runbook for low-trace-coverage scenarios.
ryan_obs: note: add an automated check that if trace sampling < 5% and SLO burn -> auto-increase sampling to 25% for 30m. filing a feature request.
alyssa_sre: agreed. good job everyone.
